issues.title: Stage 07 map-aware PPO checkpoint is not connected to the live runner
issues.description: The real runner accepted the existing P1 imitation checkpoint and proved model loading/dispatch, but it does not load map-aware-policy.pt from the multi-map PPO trainer.
issues.impact: The live result cannot be interpreted as real-SC2 evaluation or improvement of the Stage 07 self-trained policy.
issues.nextAction: Implement a RawSc2Backend environment factory for the approved launcher and validate feature_schema_hash/action contracts before loading the map-aware PPO checkpoint.

issues.title: Single-client P2 native Computer topology is not externally controllable
issues.description: The live report observes P2 units as alliance=2 and accepts P1 ally chat, but P2 remains a native Computer; no P2 participant action issuer or model acknowledgement is present.
issues.impact: P2 ML economy, production, and tactical actions cannot be claimed from this window.
issues.nextAction: Use two independent approved SC2 client/API endpoints or a map-owned control bridge with explicit ownership and action acknowledgements.

issues.title: Bounded smoke did not reach full tactical outcome
issues.description: Both runs stopped at loop 1501 with successful transport and observation, but did not satisfy the full build/train/attack/victory strategy audit.
issues.impact: No tactical win-rate or causal reward improvement can be inferred.
issues.nextAction: After the live RL bridge is connected, run a longer held-out-map evaluation with explicit terminal reward and replay-backed action attribution.
